rationale: C11 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both memoranda open by withholding approval of a specifically identified House bill, affirm that the bill's basic purpose is desirable or meritorious, isolate one included provision as the decisive objection, explain why that provision improperly alters federal policy or authority, and close by urging Congress to reconsider and reenact legislation accomplishing the bill's beneficial purpose without the objectionable provision. This sustained sequence and closely parallel language are materially stronger than mere veto-message boilerplate. C03 and C14 share the disapproval-memorandum form but use different argumentative structures and lack the child's desirable-bill/one-fatal-provision/reconsider-without-that-provision framework.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Although H.R. 6839 would grant desirable authority ... it contains a provision which would infringe upon the functions of the Executive branch to such an extent that I feel I cannot give my approval.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The basic purpose of this bill is meritorious. ... Unfortunately, however, the Congress has included one provision in this bill which I cannot approve.
shared_material.explanation: Both first endorse the bill's principal objective and then identify a single included provision as the reason approval must be withheld.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope that the Congress will, at its next session, give further consideration to legislation to accomplish the purposes of H.R. 6839, and that it will frame legislation free from the difficulties which impel me to withhold my approval from this measure.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope the Congress early in the next session will reconsider this matter carefully and will re-enact legislation to provide the school aid urgently required ... without the objectionable provision of H.R. 5411.
shared_material.explanation: The conclusions share a particularly close remedial formula: ask the next session of Congress to reconsider the measure and enact its desirable substance without the objectionable provision.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I AM withholding my approval of H.R. 6839
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I AM withholding my approval of H.R. 5411
shared_material.explanation: The opening formula is nearly identical, reinforcing the broader structural correspondence.
